Method of Attack: Compromise VOS2009/3000 softswitches to steal call metadata from internal MySQL databases
Uses Corrected Block TEA (XXTEA) cipher and Base64 encoding to obfuscate malicious functionality
Reads and decrypts encrypted database access password from configuration file
Delivers stolen information to command and control (C2) server using JSON over HTTP
Compresses and encrypts data with hardcoded RSA-1024 public key
May be inserted into boot chain masquerading as a legitimate Linknat softswitch component
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Corrected Block TEA (XXTEA) cipher
Encrypted MySQL database password in configuration file
Communication to C2 server via JSON over HTTP
